items.raw_excerpt: More holidaymakers share their frustration following Birmingham Airport baggage problems.
items.summary_en: More holidaymakers are sharing their frustration about baggage problems at Birmingham Airport. Passengers said they felt trapped on the plane because their luggage did not arrive.
items.summary_ko: 버밍엄 공항 수하물 사고로 휴가객들의 불만이 이어지고 있다. 승객들은 짐이 도착하지 않아 비행기에 갇힌 기분이었다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Passengers without luggage felt 'locked' on plane
items.title_ko: 수하물 없이 내린 승객들 "비행기에 갇힌 기분"
items.title_original: Passengers without luggage felt 'locked' on plane

items.raw_excerpt: A Wexford GP has been found guilty of professional misconduct over posts on social media during the Covid-19 pandemic which were highly critical of public health measures introduced to tackle the virus.
items.summary_en: A Wexford GP was found guilty of professional misconduct. The doctor posted messages on social media during the Covid-19 pandemic. The posts strongly criticized public health measures to fight the virus.
items.summary_ko: 웩스퍼드의 한 가정의학과 의사가 전문직 비행 판정을 받았습니다. 이 의사는 코로나19 팬데믹 기간 동안 바이러스를 막기 위한 공중보건 조치를 강하게 비난하는 글을 사회관계망에 올렸습니다.
items.title_en: GP found guilty of misconduct over Covid social posts
items.title_ko: 코로나19 팬데믹 때 SNS 게시글로 징계받은 웩스퍼드 의사

items.raw_excerpt: ¿Qué ocurrió? Pasajeros acusan larga espera y atochamientos en L1 del Metro
items.summary_en: Metro passengers in the city complain about long waiting times and crowding on Line 1. Users report the trains are packed during their commute.

items.title_en: Passengers complain of long waits and crowding on Metro L1
